versions.content: The TcpIp shall support the Fully Qualified Domain Name Option for Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 Client requirements as defined in IETF RFC 4704 (The Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 (DHCPv6) Client Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) Option). No DNS shall be supported. Only section 4 DHCPv6 Client FQDN Option and section 5 DHCPv6 Client Behavior shall be supported. Sub - Section 5.1, 5.2, 5.4 shall not be supported.

The TcpIp shall support the Fully Qualified Domain Name Option for Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 Client requirements as defined in IETF RFC 4704 (The Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 (DHCPv6) Client Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) Option). No DNS shall be supported. Only section 4 DHCPv6 Client FQDN Option and section 5 DHCPv6 Specification of TCP/IP Stack AUTO SAR CP R20 - 11 41 of 293 Document ID 617 : AUTOSAR_SWS_TcpIp Client Behavior shall be supported. Sub - Section 5.1, 5.2, 5.4 shall not be supported.
